name: Ho Chi Minh City
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: 0.8 to 1.6 average across HCMC/Mekong fringe; localized hotspots 4.6 to 7.0
literature_sources: Erban, L.E., Gorelick, S.M., & Zebker, H.A. (2014), Environmental Research Letters
Minderhoud, P.S.J. et al. (2017, 2018), Environmental Research Letters / Nature Communications
Le Ho Tong Minh et al., Ho Chi Minh City PSI InSAR subsidence studies
agreement_note: 120-day monsoon-season LOS peak (-4.2 cm LOS; -5.8 cm vertical est., ~-17.6 cm/yr vertical est.) exceeds published HCMC hotspot rates (4.6-7.0 cm/yr) by ~2.5x, with 136% reference spread (range_cm [-9.9, -4.2], n_ref=2) and 35.1% valid pixels (<40% high-confidence gate).
press_summary_gate_note: Exclude from press headlines; retain as indicative-only due to 136% reference sensitivity, 35.1% valid pixels, and monsoon atmospheric turbulence.

first_nisar_measurement.evidence: No peer-reviewed or official NASA/ISRO NISAR subsidence publication found for Ho Chi Minh City as of 2026-11-14.

quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
